name: Smith River
agency: Montana FWP / Lewis & Clark National Forest

apply.label: Apply on the FWP licensing site

items.d: Use the Montana FWP online licensing service during the application window. You can list several launch dates.
FWP emails winners. Unsuccessful applicants are not notified; results are also posted in your myfwp account.
Winners are called about two days before launch to register the party, declare boat camps and pay float fees. Rangers assign a one-hour launch window.
Every group attends a mandatory safety and orientation talk at Camp Baker on launch day.

From early March, call the Smith River reservation line (406-454-5861, weekdays 8 a.m. to noon Mountain) to pick up cancelled dates or cancel yours. The page gives two different start dates for the line, so confirm.
January 1 to February 15. The drawing is held February 18 (2026 cycle; confirm the next dates).
A separate drawing: applications through March 15, drawn March 16. The winner may launch any date that season.
A permit is required year-round. Most floats run mid-April to mid-July, with some in September and October. From May 15 to July 15 you may camp a maximum of four nights.
A small non-refundable fee per application ($15 in most FWP sources; one 2026 guide says about $10). Confirm on the licensing site.
One point per year may be bought: $5 for residents, $125 for nonresidents. Points build until you draw, then reset.
$5 each; buy as many as you like.
Per-person fees are set in the Smith River biennial rule and paid at phone registration.
Up to 15 people on one permit.
The permit covers the 59-mile float from Camp Baker to Eden Bridge with camping at designated boat camps only.
Reported cap of nine float parties per day at Camp Baker.
